properties.name: conductor.db.type
properties.description: The type of database to be used while running the Conductor application.

properties.name: conductor.indexing.enabled
properties.description: Enable indexing to elasticsearch. If set to false, a no-op implementation will be used.

properties.name: conductor.account-deletion.enabled
properties.description: Enable the Central-integrated account data deletion feature (consume ACCOUNT_DELETION_REQUESTED, hard delete, publish ACCOUNT_DELETION_STATUS).

properties.name: conductor.account-deletion.service
properties.description: This service's FreshID-registered service name, emitted in the ACCOUNT_DELETION_STATUS payload.

properties.name: conductor.account-deletion.pod
properties.description: Deployment pod forwarded to the collector envelope.

properties.name: conductor.account-deletion.region
properties.description: Deployment region forwarded to the collector envelope.

properties.name: conductor.account-deletion.purge-threads
properties.description: Number of threads used to run account purges asynchronously.

properties.name: conductor.account-deletion.max-purge-passes
properties.description: Max enumerate-then-delete passes before a purge is considered incomplete.

properties.name: conductor.account-deletion.status-topic
properties.description: Kafka topic that ACCOUNT_DELETION_STATUS events are published to.

properties.name: conductor.account-deletion.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: Retry attempts for transient failures during deletion and status publishing.
